subject: A Couple of Bugs (?) in shinyapp Relating to Var Names and Special Characters

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: A Couple of Bugs (?) in shinyapp Relating to Var Names and Special Characters
parts:
Thank you for developing such an awesome product!  It has definitely created opportunities for many that would have not otherwise have been possible without such a toolset.


I find this bug in the conditionalPanel where an input element containing a period in the variable name will not work as expected.  However, if I change the input element from x.category to xcategory, it will work, and the conditional panel will be hidden unless "Continuous" is clicked.


                radioButtons("x.category", "Describe the Field", c("Categorical"="category","Continuous"="continuous"), selected = "Categorical"),

                conditionalPanel(

                    condition = "input.x.category == 'continuous'",

                    ........

                ),


For the time being, I am recoding my inputs to avoid using periods, but maybe this is something that can be fixed in a future release.


My second bug relates to sending special characters to the renderPlot.  I have a Text Input that represents the Title of my plot.


textInput(inputId="mainTitle", label="Main Title", value = "My Main Title Modify Me")

However, on the output it shows up as "My Main TitleModify Me"  Moreover, if on the text box I manually input "My Main Title Modify Me", it then shows up on the output as "My Main Title Modify Me" without recognizing the newline character that works in Base R.

Is there another way I can insert a newline character into my plots?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: A Couple of Bugs (?) in shinyapp Relating to Var Names and Special Characters
parts:
Hello, 

 Never use an input name containing a point such as x.category.

In ui.R, input.x.category is not some R language, this is some Javascript language, and this is similar to input$x$category in R language.

>>>  use x_category instead of x.category, for example.

messages.subject: Re: A Couple of Bugs (?) in shinyapp Relating to Var Names and Special Characters
parts: Thanks Stephane. I guess that takes care of the first "issue" because it arises from doing something that does not comport with variable naming conventions in R.  I am still trying to figure out how to put in the newline character into my plots.

messages.subject: Re: A Couple of Bugs (?) in shinyapp Relating to Var Names and Special Characters

You're right about "\n", I had never noticed that before. 
For text input with multiple lines, I would use the ace editor provided by the shinyAce package, instead of textInput().

parts:
How would I use it in my case?

In the documentation it has for the defaults: aceEditor(outputId, value, mode, theme, readOnly = FALSE, height = "400px", fontSize = 12)

A) Do I put this in my UI.R file?
B) What would my outputID correspond to if in my case I want the value to just be accessible to the server.R file?
C) Will the next update to shinyapp include support for the newline character as well as other escape commands?
